effect: Adds an opt-in zero-copy scan replay oracle and benchmark harness for testing the experimental move-to-front fold.

measured: -10.5% serial scan, -1.9% wall at 8 threads and -4.0% wall at 10 threads on Wikidata x4 (stopped under its 10-thread adoption rule; 0 guard regressions), i9
